proof_body:
by
  intro a h0
  constructor
  · intro hm
    have hs := hm.hasProd.tendsto_prod_nat
    have hmono : Monotone (fun n => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 + a i)) := by
      refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fun n => ?_)
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
      have : 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 + a i) := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => by linarith [h0 i])
      nlinarith [h0 n]
    have hle : ∀ n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i ≤ ∏' n, (1 + a n) := by
      intro n
      have h1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i ≤ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 + a i) := by
        induction n with
        | zero => simp
        | succ k ih =>
          rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.prod_range_succ]
          have hp : 1 ≤ ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 + a i) := by
            have := Finset.prod_le_prod (s := Finset.range k) (f := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (g := fun i => 1 + a i) (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) (fun i _ => by linarith [h0 i])
            simpa using this
          nlinarith [h0 k]
      exact h1.trans (hmono.ge_of_tendsto hs n)
    exact summable_of_sum_range_le h0 hle
  · intro hs
    exact Real.multipliable_one_add_of_summable hs
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) → (Multipliable (fun n => 1 + a n) ↔ Summable a)
